name: ClinicBench
intro: ClinicBench是牛津大学和哈佛大学联合发布的临床场景大模型评测基准，涵盖临床语言生成、理解和推理等11个任务，引入了六个新数据集和复杂临床任务，全面评估LLM的临床能力。
org: University of Oxford, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health
build_method: 整合11个已有数据集；Referral QA与药理问答分别基于MIMIC-IV和DrugBank，经GPT-4生成及专家复核；治疗推荐来自ChatDoctor，住院总结与患者教育来自MIMIC-IV/III，药物相互作用来自Drugs.com的Moderna记录
metric: Accuracy、ROUGE-L、F1，以及事实性、完整性、偏好和安全性的盲评胜平率
task_type: 多选题, 问答, 摘要, 实体识别, 关系抽取, 分类
eval_feature: 评估LLM在复杂临床问题解决, 临床语言理解, 生成和推理方面的能力
scale: 3类场景、11个任务、17个数据集、超过20,000个测试样本
task_type_en: Multiple choice, Q&A, Summarization, Named Entity Recognition, Relation Extraction, Classification
build_method_en: Combine 11 existing datasets; build Referral QA from MIMIC-IV and Pharmacology QA from DrugBank with GPT-4 generation and expert review; derive Treatment Recommendation from ChatDoctor, Hospitalization and Patient Education from MIMIC-IV/III, and Drug Interaction from Drugs.com Moderna records
eval_feature_en: Evaluating LLM capabilities in complex clinical problem solving, clinical language understanding, generation, and reasoning
intro_en: ClinicBench, jointly released by Oxford University and Harvard University, is a clinical scenario large model evaluation benchmark covering 11 tasks including clinical language generation, understanding, and reasoning. It introduces six new datasets and complex clinical tasks to comprehensively assess the clinical capabilities of LLMs.

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2405.00716v4, Table 1, §§3, 4.1, 4.4–4.5, and the official GitHub snapshot 57138be8a73f09bef8980f849789baf57570c5cf. The six new datasets have distinct sources and quality-control paths. Referral QA starts from 1,000 MIMIC-IV referral letters, uses GPT-4 to generate medication and treatment QA pairs, then expert review, correction, and filtering yields 1,057 pairs. Treatment Recommendation directly collects 796 ChatDoctor patient-physician conversations and their physician drug recommendations. Hospitalization Summarization uses 382 MIMIC-IV clinical-document and summary pairs; Patient Education uses 181 MIMIC-III health-document and instruction pairs. Pharmacology QA selects 213 DrugBank drugs released from October 2023 through April 2024, uses GPT-4 to generate QA pairs, and applies expert review. Drug Interaction samples 100 known interactions and 100 non-interactions for the Moderna COVID-19 vaccine (2023–2024 formula) from Drugs.com. For each new clinical task, three prompts are compared on 100 samples with LLaMA-2 7B/13B/70B and the best is used on the full set. Twenty-two LLMs (11 general, 11 medical) are evaluated zero-shot and 1/3/5-shot. Three blinded medical experts compare public-LLM outputs with GPT-4 on 100 samples each from two generation tasks and report win+tie rates. Release drift: the pinned repository exposes five novel-data files; Referral QA is absent, and Patient-Education.csv has 3,621 rows while the paper test subset is 181 pairs.
